chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Harun Ziyad, from Harun ibn Muslim, from one of his men, from Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him)

That one of the Banu Hashim invited him along with a group of his family. So he came with a young girl of his, and the people of the gathering all brought her near to them. So when she approached him, he asked about her age. So it was said, 'Five'. So he forbade her from it.

key_terms.فَنَحَّاهَا: So he forbade her / kept her away

ai.seo_question: What is the age limit for kissing a young girl in Shia jurisprudence according to Imam al-Rida?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him), a five-year-old girl from Banu Hashim was presented to the gathering, where she was kissed by the attendees, establishing the permissibility of kissing young girls before the onset of puberty. This incident is frequently cited by Shia jurists to distinguish between the age of seven (often associated with the beginning of specific legal responsibilities or 'bulugh' in certain contexts) and the actual biological marker of puberty, clarifying that pre-pubertal children are not subject to the same restrictions as adults. The hadith underscores the gentle familial bonds within the Ahl al-Bayt and provides a foundational precedent for the fiqh of 'muqabba' (kissing) regarding young children.
